news.headline: A Baby Bonobo Arrives in Florida
news.body: The Jacksonville Zoo and Botanical Gardens welcomed a brand-new baby bonobo! Mom Kimia gave birth just before 10 p.m. on November 3, and keepers say both mom and baby are doing well. It is the zoo's first bonobo birth in more than 10 years. Bonobos are endangered apes from Central Africa, and the zoo is giving the pair quiet time to settle in while the care team checks on them.

news.headline: Some Cats Are Shy — Just Like Kids
news.body: Scientists at Kyoto University in Japan studied 310 pet cats and found four personality types, including a shy group that is both fearful and curious at once. That mix is a lot like young children who want to say hello but feel a little nervous. The researchers say cats are more complex than simply friendly or timid, and understanding each cat's style can help pets feel safer at home and in shelters.

news.headline: 153,862 Readers Set a World Record
news.body: Book lovers in 92 countries teamed up for a giant online reading party and set a Guinness World Record for the most people reading online in 12 hours. About 153,862 readers joined schools, libraries, and families for the Take 10 To Read challenge. On November 4, kids at a London primary school helped celebrate when the record was officially announced.

fun_fact: Bonobos and chimpanzees are humans' closest living animal relatives. Scientists say we share nearly 99 percent of our DNA with them! 🦧
